sessions.phase_label: Onboarding, task-system setup, and initial assignments
CJ Dropshipping training, task execution, and outreach planning
E-commerce catalog work, Airbnb outreach, and content-bank development
Performance reset, independent-work expectations, and final assignments

requirements.title: Maintain Correct ClickUp Task Status
requirements.definition: Mark completed work in ClickUp while closing completed subtasks and leaving parent Goal tasks open.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers task-status maintenance only; completing the underlying assignments and storing their artifacts are separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Store Complete Task Artifacts in Linked Documents
requirements.definition: Place completed work and required supporting links in the Google document, sheet, or folder linked from each task.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the common artifact-submission mechanism, not the substantive correctness of CRM, Pinterest, product, or content assignments.

requirements.title: Complete Daily and Scheduled Assignments on Time
requirements.definition: Complete the daily checklist and scheduled assignments within the applicable shift and task deadlines.
requirements.boundary_note: Deadline and daily-volume expectations are attributes of work completion; independently testable assignment outputs remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Execute Routine Work Independently
requirements.definition: Proceed proactively on routine tasks without waiting for step-by-step confirmation, then report completed actions for review or correction.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers decision autonomy and initiative, not task speed, task tracking, or the substantive output of individual assignments.

requirements.title: Obtain Bitwarden Vault Access
requirements.definition: Accept and use the Bitwarden invitation needed to access the shared default collection.
requirements.boundary_note: Vault entry is separate from whether shared credentials inside the vault are visible and usable.

requirements.title: View Shared Credentials Through Bitwarden
requirements.definition: Be able to view the shared account credentials needed for assigned applications through the Bitwarden browser or extension path.
requirements.boundary_note: Records credential-visibility behavior without recording or inferring any secret values; successful application login is a separate Requirement.

requirements.title: Establish Canva and Adobe Express Access
requirements.definition: Log into the assigned Canva and Adobe Express accounts for subsequent content work.
requirements.boundary_note: The two application logins form one tightly coupled onboarding task in the available evidence; Bitwarden visibility is tracked separately because it has its own failure trajectory.

requirements.title: Establish Thai Market Finds Meta Access
requirements.definition: Accept and use access to the Thai Market Finds Meta account for assigned social-media work.
requirements.boundary_note: Thai Market Finds access is separate from Southern Drive access because the accounts were enabled and scheduled independently.

requirements.title: Establish Southern Drive Meta Access
requirements.definition: Accept access to the Southern Drive Mobility Facebook and Instagram accounts when the client makes the invitations available.
requirements.boundary_note: Kept separate from Thai Market Finds access because Southern Drive enablement was postponed while Thai Market Finds work continued.

requirements.title: Establish Airbnb Account Access
requirements.definition: Log into the assigned Airbnb account so host outreach and lead follow-up can be performed.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers account enablement only; sending outreach, tracking leads, and coordinating interested hosts are separate behaviors.

requirements.title: Establish TikTok Business Access
requirements.definition: Obtain access to the business TikTok account required for social and commerce tasks.
requirements.boundary_note: Account access is distinct from listing products in TikTok Shop or generating TikTok content.

requirements.title: Research and Select CJ Dropshipping Products
requirements.definition: Identify promising products using trend evidence and CJ supplier signals, select the required daily quantity, and add the selected products to the working list.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers selection and research criteria; Shopify publication, TikTok Shop publication, and cross-channel tracking can fail independently and remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Publish Selected Products to Shopify
requirements.definition: List selected CJ Dropshipping products on the Thai Market Finds Shopify website using the required category placement.
requirements.boundary_note: Shopify publication is independent from TikTok Shop publication, as shown by Shopify work proceeding and completing while the TikTok path encountered an error.

requirements.title: Publish Selected Products to TikTok Shop
requirements.definition: List the selected CJ Dropshipping products in TikTok Shop using the platform-provided product type information.
requirements.boundary_note: Separated from Shopify listing because the TikTok path has its own instructions and runtime failure trajectory.

requirements.title: Maintain Cross-Channel Product Listing Records
requirements.definition: Maintain one spreadsheet recording selected products and whether each is intended for or listed on TikTok Shop and the website.
requirements.boundary_note: The spreadsheet is a reusable tracking artifact, independent from performing the actual channel listings.

requirements.title: Send Airbnb Host Outreach
requirements.definition: Rapidly identify Airbnb hosts across target areas and send the approved collaboration message without unnecessary listing-review research.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers initial message delivery only; recording interested leads, following up on active conversations, and entering secured leads into HubSpot are separate stages.

requirements.title: Track Interested Airbnb Leads
requirements.definition: Record only hosts who respond positively or want to move forward in the outreach spreadsheet.
requirements.boundary_note: Lead qualification and spreadsheet entry are distinct from sending initial outreach and from later CRM entry after an engagement is secured.

requirements.title: Advance Interested Airbnb Host Conversations
requirements.definition: Guide interested hosts toward a tentative or definite visit date and coordinate the next content-visit steps.
requirements.boundary_note: Follow-up begins after host engagement and is independently actionable from high-volume initial outreach.

requirements.title: Add Secured Host Engagements to HubSpot
requirements.definition: Enter host information into HubSpot only after the host engagement and visit scheduling are fully secured.
requirements.boundary_note: HubSpot entry is a later pipeline stage; the spreadsheet remains the working store before a host is secured.

requirements.title: Research Tools Supporting Outreach Work
requirements.definition: Research useful tools that could make the recurring outreach process easier or more efficient.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an independently requested research deliverable rather than generic debugging or an incidental method of performing outreach.

requirements.title: Build and Maintain the Google Content Bank
requirements.definition: Create and populate a reusable Google Sheets content bank for subsequent social-media scheduling and publication.
requirements.boundary_note: The content repository is separate from generating brand-specific content and from scheduling or publishing posts.

requirements.title: Schedule and Publish Daily Social Content
requirements.definition: Use content from the content bank to schedule and publish daily posts through the assigned applications.
requirements.boundary_note: Publication is independently actionable from content-bank maintenance and from producing new AI-assisted content.

requirements.title: Generate Southern Drive Mobility Content
requirements.definition: Create a batch of Southern Drive Mobility promotional posts covering rentals, diagnostics, scanner services, and vehicle sales using the supplied business details and examples.
requirements.boundary_note: Southern Drive automotive content has different subject matter and acceptance details from Thai Market Finds travel and shopping content.

requirements.title: Generate Thai Market Finds TikTok Content
requirements.definition: Use TikTok Creator Search Insights and AI Canvas to create Thai Market Finds posts with relevant topics, platform search information, brand-specific recommendations, and calls to action.
requirements.boundary_note: Kept separate from Southern Drive content because the brands, topics, workflow details, and acceptance criteria can change independently.

requirements.title: Complete Pinterest Competitor Research
requirements.definition: Research and record suitable Pinterest competitor profiles for Pinterest Task 1, including later corrections requiring additional profiles.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the identifiable Pinterest Task 1 competitor-research output; Pinterest Task 2 lacks enough semantic detail to merge or model safely.

requirements.title: Complete the CRM Structure Document
requirements.definition: Complete the Build CRM Structure assignment in the designated task document so the client can see the updated CRM work.
requirements.boundary_note: The substantive CRM Structure assignment is separate from the project-wide rule requiring all task artifacts to be stored in linked documents.

unresolved_candidates.description: The client prohibits AI for an initial set of fact-based assignments, but the affected task set is not identified precisely enough to define a stable Requirement boundary.
Pinterest Task 2 is reported complete, but its requested behavior and acceptance criteria are absent from the supplied evidence.
CJ Dropshipping Tasks 1 and 2 may contain distinct deliverables, but the visible evidence does not define them clearly enough to split them beyond the later product-research workflow.
The handling of work that exceeds the six-hour shift remains unresolved: the freelancer asks whether to stop or continue without billing, and no client answer is visible.
The exact content-volume allocation between Southern Drive Mobility and Thai Market Finds is unclear because the message mentions multiple quantities across both workflows.
